We are seeking a PhD candidate and postdoctoral researcher to investigate how AI can support creative work, with a focus towards sustainable architectural design practice. Successful applicants will join a diverse team in an international HCI research environment committed to research excellence and a supportive working atmosphere.

These are three-year, fully funded positions.

Start date: August 2026.

Location: Aalborg, Denmark.
